summary.text: Michael Murphy is a Republican member of the Kansas Senate representing District 34 (Reno County), and the Legislature's member page lists service in the Senate since 2025.
Michael Murphy is listed as a vice chair of the Government Efficiency Committee.

paragraphs.text: According to the same page, Michael Murphy served in the House (2021–2024) before the current service in the Senate that began in 2025.
Michael Murphy is listed as a member of the Government Efficiency Committee, the Education Committee, the Federal and State Affairs Committee and the Public Health and Welfare Committee.
The page names Janis Murphy as Michael Murphy's spouse.
